main_text.p: craftino crapulæ memineris hefternæ. Vos olim, ô Romani libertatem fecistis bello, vos etiam pacis, estote discipuli, annunciantibus vobis Persis, vt la-chrymosum bellum excutiatis. Qui enim primò peccant, illos etiam correctionis decet pœnitentia. Ne putetis confidentiam esse hanc meam tam humanam orationem. Cum enim nullius indigeat Persarum rex, heri forte vel nudius tertius, quando suam terram ausus est calcare Romanus exercitus, prælio congredi renuit. Auro enim multo, donisque lautis emere Romanos pacem iubet, nec sane pro pœna bellum imponere peccantibus fas est: quia multa pecuniaria & Persi-cum animum placare, & ferociâ Romanorum bellica expletam tuba, non nequit comprimere. Cùm orationem adhuc extenderet legatus adversa om-nium contra cum exsibilantium tollebantur sufragia, clamore insuper ingenti, quasi graviter se-rentium orationem barbari. Elatis enim videbantur esse animis, propter illas quas primum experti fuerant res prosperas, quum & Persarum disturbarunt ordines, & prædis spoliisq; potiti Cardarigam circumuenerunt. Dimissâ verò ab Imperatore concione, Persa dicendi finem fecit: nec multis post diebus Nisibidis antistes honore sacerdotali præfulgens, ad ducem abiit, eademque Metodis verba in medium proponit: quæ cum dux per tabellarium ad regem scripsisset, agnito Imperatoris sigillo ducis edicto, statim facto, Philippi-cum iussit impurissimas has inducias thissum facere, tanquam obstante Romana magnanimi-tate. page.notes: Top line begins with a damaged first letter ("eraftino"), read as "craftino" with uncertainty; the word itself may be a printing error for "crastino". Page number read as 58 but uncertain. Long s has been normalised to plain s throughout, and u/v and i/j regularised. Doubtful readings: "Duxigitur" (possibly printer's error), "Cardarigam", "Metodis", "thissum", "Nisibidis", "Philippi-cum" and several words at line ends in the lower half. Left margin fragments are cropped at the scan edge and cannot be read, so they are omitted. Right-edge marks are show-through and are omitted. Paragraph breaks: no indented line appears, so the page is one continuous paragraph.
